details: The U.S. September Consumer Price Index (CPI) came in hotter than expected, rising 3.7% year-over-year, exceeding the 3.6% forecast. Core CPI also surpassed projections. This unexpected increase in inflation has significantly boosted expectations for a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in October, with probabilities now around 37%. Following this news, Bitcoin fell below $82,000, reflecting a broader market retreat from speculative assets. This comes amidst a challenging October for crypto, further evidenced by spot Bitcoin ETFs recording $65 million in net outflows on Monday, contributing to a negative total of $451 million in October, indicating softening institutional demand.
title: US Inflation Surges, Raising Fed Rate Hike Odds; Bitcoin Falls Below $82K
